items.name: Message from A
items.what: Creators receive a fake anonymous text message signed 'A' that humorously exposes a relatable or slightly embarrassing daily habit while they perform that action on screen.
items.format: Text-on-screen overlay on daily routine video

items.name: WTF is…
items.what: Creators write 'wtf is...' on screen to feign ignorance about a popular concept or trend, while showing their own alternative choice as the response.

items.name: Can I try your…
items.what: Two friends ask 'Can I try yours?' and swap products like drinks or beauty items to capture genuine, spontaneous reactions.
items.format: Product exchange and reaction test video

items.name: Some people call me…
items.what: Creators hook viewers with a nickname or inside joke about themselves, then explain the unique habit or product benefit behind that label.
items.format: Text hook with talking head and product showcase

items.name: Things you should definitely ghost
items.what: In a Halloween-themed format, creators dress up as ghosts holding signboards listing common industry mistakes or bad habits to avoid, finishing with the proper solution.
items.format: Skit with signboards in ghost costume
